{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''battle chant''' was sometimes sung by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] prior to engaging in battle. The chant was short, sung in the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] of [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']], and was the nearest parallel to a [[Prayer/Legends|prayer]] that could be found in contemporary Mandalorian culture.<ref name="TMPaC">{{InsiderCite|86|The Mandalorians: People and Culture}}</ref>

==Chant==
===''Mando'a''===
''Oya'cye''<br />
''Kyr'am''<br />
''Mare'cye''<br />
''Darasuum''<br />
''Oya! Oya!''<br />

===[[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]===
Life<br />
[[Death/Legends|Death]]<br />
Revelation<br />
Eternity<br />
Let's live! Let's hunt!<br />

==Behind the scenes==
This unnamed Mandalorian chant was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' article, ''[[The Mandalorians: People and Culture]]''. Written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], the article was published in [[February]] of [[2006]], as part of the Insider magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 86|eighty-sixth issue]].
